title: On semi-stable integral models for Shimura varieties
summary: We construct (potentially) semi-stable integral models for a class of Shimura varieties with maximal parahoric level at an odd prime $p$. The main input is an explicit construction of semi-stable equivariant modifications of the relevant canonical local models, where the underlying groups are Weil restrictions of unramified unitary similitude groups, symplectic similitude groups, or even orthogonal similitude groups.
